title: Quasi-isomorphism of the specified scalar pullback chain comparison
statement: Let ell be prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_ell, iota:E→L a coefficient embedding, f:X→Y any scheme morphism, and P a good (K-flat and termwise-flat) complex of completed E-coefficient sheaves [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. The specified chain map scalarPullbackChain [lem-pur-integral-scalar-finite-comparison-models], obtained from the normalized strict finite-level pullback tower maps by the diagonal Roos comparison, is a quasi-isomorphism. This is the proved specialization of [lem-pur-integral-scalar-pullback-roos-quasi-iso]; its naturality is proved in the same module.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; derived.tex Tag 08TC. Specialization of the normalized cofinal-filtration comparison to the prescribed strict maps.

proof.text: For naturality, compose the generic diagonal Roos natural transformation in ScalarRoosComparison with the specified strict tower transformation. For the quasi-isomorphism, unfold the specified scalarPullbackChain and apply integralScalarPullbackRoosQuasiIso. At each finite level, the chosen tower normalization identifies the component with scalarPullbackLevel; its chosen generator equation supplies the required generator hypothesis. The chosen scalarRoosMap normalization supplies both product-coordinate hypotheses. This is a complete Lean specialization, with no new hole.
